niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency because the right partner depends on your company size, budget, and whether you need B2B pipeline tracking or mass-market consumer reach. Reddit·r/programmatic
Top agencies and platforms stand out across specific use cases:
DirectiveBest for B2B companies, SaaS, and tech brands. It connects CTV advertising directly to pipeline, revenue, multi-touch attribution, and full-funnel RevOps rather than just brand awareness.
TatariBest for convergent TV (streaming + linear). Its platform-led approach lets brands plan, buy, manage, and measure video campaigns across both streaming apps and traditional linear television with digital-style performance visibility.
Marketing ArchitectsBest for brands entering TV advertising for the first time. It handles end-to-end media planning, creative production, testing frameworks, and response measurement across streaming and broadcast.
Chamber MediaBest for performance creative and e-commerce. It specializes in AI-driven video production and high-converting direct-response ads tailored for platforms like Amazon CTV, Hulu, and Peacock.
Socium MediaBest for mid-market brands running structured testing phases. They build full-funnel prospecting and remarketing roadmaps (typically requiring a $50,000+ monthly ad spend).
The Trade Desk & Amazon DSPBest for self-serve programmatic buying. If you prefer managing campaigns in-house using enterprise demand-side platforms (DSPs) with first-party audience data, these are industry standards. Business of Apps +4
How to Choose the Right CTV Partner
According to community consensus on Reddit, the CTV landscape is heavily fragmented, meaning no single agency or DSP covers 100% of inventory or fits every goal. When evaluating agencies, look at: Reddit·r/programmatic
Attribution model: Do they measure simple brand impressions, or do they tie CTV exposure to website visits, CRM leads, and closed sales?
Minimum spend requirements: Many specialized CTV agencies require monthly ad budgets ranging from $10,000 to $50,000+.
Creative capabilities: CTV requires high-definition, unskippable full-screen video ads (often 15 or 30 seconds) rather than repurposed social media clips. Paramount Ads Manager +2
What is your industry or product (e.g., B2B SaaS, e-commerce, local services)?
What is your approximate monthly or campaign budget?
Are you trying to drive direct sales/leads or brand awareness?
